options.reason: The table is a TCGA pan-gene expression matrix with a single categorical annotation, PAM50, giving the five intrinsic subtypes, so the evidently intended task is five-class molecular subtype prediction from expression (multiclass). PAM50 is a clinically derived label from the expression profile, not a component column in this schema, so only sample_id is flagged as an identifier, while the thousands of gene columns are the intended inputs. Model selection and tuning happen on TCGA only, with CPTAC used once as an external test set; because CPTAC lacks Normal-like tumours, evaluation must score macro-F1, per-class P/R and the confusion matrix over the classes actually present rather than assume the full five-class label set.
options.title: multiclass
